title: Apple services including the App Store and Apple Music go down; Apple points to an internal update
summary: Several Apple services stopped working for part of November 17, 2026. Apple's status page listed full outages for Apple Music, the App Store and AppleCare, and reports named iCloud among the services hit. Apple attributed the problem to an internal update and said it was not the result of a cyberattack. The outage followed a Microsoft 365 disruption the week before.
why: If your team relies on one provider for email, files and sign-in, keep a backup way to reach customers and key documents.
